_notes: Source: the Town Clerk's "Results of elections" sheet, supplied 2026-08-28 in answer to the owner's public-records request, covering 2022-2026. IT IS A WINNER-AND-COUNT LIST FOR THE PRINCIPAL TOWN OFFICES, NOT A RETURN: it carries no blanks, no write-in totals and no ballot questions, and it omits the School Committee in both years where an independent source shows one was elected (2023, per the Berkshire Eagle; 2026, per the town's own caucus notice nominating Jen Welch). The ballot figure is therefore a CEILING and no race can be closed against it. Election date 2022-05-24 established from the town's own post of 2022-04-03, "Upcoming New Ashford Important Dates": "Town Elections - May 24, 2022, from 2:00PM-4:00PM and 6:00PM-8:00PM". WHY THERE IS NO TOWN-PUBLISHED DOCUMENT FOR THIS YEAR: New Ashford posted its annual election results to its own site every year from 2015 to 2021 (Elections2015.jpg, Elections2016-Results.jpg, Elections2017-Results.pdf, 2018NewAshfordTownElectionsResults.pdf, ElectionResultMay2019.pdf, NewAshford-May25-2021-Elections.pdf; 2020 was the COVID year) and then STOPPED. A full enumeration of the town's WordPress media library on 2026-08-28 -- all 1,064 items, not a keyword search -- returns no annual-election results file of any kind after May 2021. The only later election documents are state-election administrivia (DeadlineToRequestMailInBallot 2022, ElectionUpdates 2024, town-results.pdf of 2024-11-06 which is the NOVEMBER 5 2024 STATE ELECTION and not a town return despite its filename) and the 2026 caucus notice. So the clerk's summary sheet is not merely the best source for 2022-2026, it is the only one the town has produced. SCHOOL COMMITTEE IS MISSING FROM THIS RECORD AND A SEAT WAS ALMOST CERTAINLY UP. The town's own posted ballots show a School Committee 3-year seat on the ballot in 2017 (Jen Welch, on write-ins), 2018 (Brenda Frye), 2019 (Lori Jayko) and 2021 (Frye again), and independent sources show one in 2023 (Eagle: Welch def. Scace) and 2026 (caucus notice: Jen Welch nominated). Three staggered three-year seats means one falls due EVERY year, so the office cannot legitimately vanish. The clerk's summary sheet simply does not carry it -- nor the Cemetery Committee, whose one-year terms are also up every year. This is NOT the 2021 restructure: that made the Town Clerk appointed (2021 ballot question, passed 44-36) and had already removed Tree Warden, Fire Warden and Library Trustee, but a School Committee is state-mandated and elected. See research/newashford_office_cycle.md.
